description.en: An audio production workstation for DeepSeek Harness. Renders note-level scores from local SoundFont banks, synthesizes narration and singing, offers a sound-effect library of recordings and generators, and places every generated audio as an editable clip on a timeline for auditioning, balancing and mixing into video.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的音频制作工作站。通过本地 SoundFont 音源渲染音符乐谱，合成旁白与歌声，提供录音素材与程序化音效库，并将每个生成的声音作为可编辑片段落到时间轴上，支持逐轨试听、调节以及混音输出到视频。
